targets.rawSql: SELECT account_name as "Account", COUNT(*) as "Tickets", MAX(account_seat_count) as "Seats", MAX(account_arr) as "ARR ($)", ROUND(AVG(csat_score)::numeric, 1) as "Avg CSAT", MAX(account_tier) as "Tier", STRING_AGG(DISTINCT category, ', ') as "Categories" FROM tickets WHERE is_enterprise = true AND account_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY account_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, AVG(csat_score) ASC

targets.rawSql: SELECT ticket_id, created_at::date as "Date", category, priority_assigned as "Priority", first_response_min as "FRT (min)", csat_score as "CSAT", COALESCE(triage_routing, 'pending') as "Routing" FROM tickets WHERE account_name = 'DataForge' ORDER BY created_at ASC
